mapper.update: /* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.updateDeployProc */ UPDATE KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC SET DEPLOY_CD = (SELECT COMN_CD FROM KOA_TB_COMN_CD WHERE (SORT_ODRG = (SELECT (AA.SORT_ODRG + 1) FROM KOA_TB_COMN_CD AA INNER JOIN KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC BB ON (AA.COMN_CD = BB.DEPLOY_CD) WHERE BB.SEQ = #{seq})) AND (GROUP_CD = 'DEPLOY1000') ) ,UPDATE_DT = NOW() ,UPDATE_USR = #{regr} WHERE (KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC.SEQ = #{seq})
mapper.insert: /* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.insertProcHst */ INSERT INTO KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC_HST (PROC_SEQ ,API_NO ,VERIFI_CD ,DEPLOY_ST_DT ,REGR ,DEPLOY_ADM ,DEPLOY_CD ,USE_YN ,REG_DT ,UPDATE_DT ,BIGO ,UPDATE_USR ,HST_INSERT_USER) SELECT SEQ, API_NO, VERIFI_CD, DEPLOY_ST_DT, REGR, DEPLOY_ADM, DEPLOY_CD, USE_YN, REG_DT, UPDATE_DT, BIGO, UPDATE_USR, #{regr} FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC WHERE (SEQ = #{seq})
mapper.select: /* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selCommCodeList */ SELECT COMN_CD, GROUP_CD_NM, CD_NM FROM KOA_TB_COMN_CD WHERE GROUP_CD = #{groupCd} AND PRNTS_CD IS NOT NULL

/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selDeployView */ SELECT DEPLOYPROC.SEQ, DEPLOYPROC.API_NO, DEPLOYPROC.DEPLOY_CD, DEPLOYPROC.VERIFI_CD, DEPLOYPROC.DEPLOY_ST_DT, DEPLOYPROC.REGR, DEPLOYPROC.DEPLOY_ADM, DEPLOYPROC.USE_YN, TO_CHAR(DEPLOYPROC.REG_DT, 'Mon DD YYYY') REG_DT, COMNCD.PRNTS_CD, APIDEF.API_NM, APIDEF.API_PATH, VERICD.CD_NM AS VERICD_NM, SPC.API_NM CTGRY_NM, APISYSTEM.SYS_NM, DEPLOYPROC.BIGO, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_HST WHERE DEPLOY_PROC_SEQ = DEPLOYPROC.SEQ AND DEPLOY_GB = 'T' ) AS TB_CNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_HST WHERE DEPLOY_PROC_SEQ = DEPLOYPROC.SEQ AND DEPLOY_GB = 'T' ) AS TB_SUCCESS_CNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_HST WHERE DEPLOY_PROC_SEQ = DEPLOYPROC.SEQ AND DEPLOY_GB = 'C' ) AS CB_CNT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KOA_TB_API_VERI_CONDITION WHERE DEPLOY_PROC_SEQ = DEPLOYPROC.SEQ AND DEL_YN = 'N' ) AS VERIFI_CNT , COALESCE((SELECT CD_NM FROM KOA_TB_COMN_CD WHERE COMN_CD = APIDEF.API_HANDLER_CD ),'') AS HANDLER_NM , COALESCE(APIDEF.ENDPNT_TB_URL,'') AS ENDPNT_TB_URL, APIDEF.API_ID, APIDEF.API_VER, (SELECT count(*) cnt FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM WHERE PARAM_NM IN ('bizHeader','orderId','cbSvcName','cbFnName') AND PARAM_TYPE_CD = 'PRMTYP1010' AND REQUIRED = 'Y' AND API_NO = APIDEF.API_NO ) REQUIRED_CNT FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC AS DEPLOYPROC INNER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD AS COMNCD ON DEPLOYPROC.DEPLOY_CD = COMNCD.COMN_CD INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF AS APIDEF ON DEPLOYPROC.API_NO = APIDEF.API_NO INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC AS SPC ON APIDEF.API_SPC_NO = SPC.API_SPC_NO INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM AS APISYSTEM ON SPC.SYS_ID = APISYSTEM.SYS_ID INNER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD AS VERICD ON DEPLOYPROC.VERIFI_CD = VERICD.COMN_CD WHERE DEPLOYPROC.SEQ = #{seq}
/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selSystemList */ SELECT SYS_ID, SYS_NM, URL, REG_DT, REGR, AMD_DT, AMDR, SORT_ODRG, SUB_SORT_ODRG FROM KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM ORDER BY SYS_NM ASC

/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selSpcList */ SELECT APISPC.API_SPC_NO, API_SPC_ID, VER, API_NM, SYS_ID FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC AS APISPC INNER JOIN (SELECT API_SPC_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF GROUP BY API_SPC_NO ) AS APIDEF ON APISPC.API_SPC_NO = APIDEF.API_SPC_NO WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND SYS_ID = #{sysId}

/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selDeployProposeContent */ SELECT DPROC.SEQ , APIDEF.API_NM, APISYSTEM.SYS_NM, SPC.API_NM SERVICE_NM, APPLY.BIGO, DPROC.SEQ DEPLOY_PROC_SEQ FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_APPLY AS APPLY INNER JOIN KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC AS DPROC ON APPLY.DEPLOY_PROC_SEQ = DPROC.SEQ INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF AS APIDEF ON DPROC.API_NO = APIDEF.API_NO INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC AS SPC ON APIDEF.API_SPC_NO = SPC.API_SPC_NO INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM AS APISYSTEM ON SPC.SYS_ID = APISYSTEM.SYS_ID WHERE APPLY.SEQ = #{deployApplySeq}

/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selCbDeployView */ SELECT TO_CHAR(DEPLOY_HST.DEPLOY_DATE, 'Mon DD YYYY') DEPLOY_DATE, DEPLOY_HST.SUCCESS_YN, DEPLOY_HST.RESULT_MSG FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_APPLY AS DEPLOY_APPLY INNER JOIN KOA_TB_DEPLOY_HST AS DEPLOY_HST ON DEPLOY_APPLY.SEQ = DEPLOY_HST.DEPLOY_APPLY_SEQ WHERE DEPLOY_APPLY.SEQ = #{deployApplySeq}

/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selTbDeployHst */
SELECT A.SUCCESS_YN , TO_CHAR(A.DEPLOY_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS DEPLOY_DATE , A.RESULT_MSG , A.API_NO , A.LOG_SEQ FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_HST AS A WHERE (A.API_NO = #{apiNo})
AND (A.DEPLOY_GB = #{deployGb})
ORDER BY A.SEQ DESC
SELECT A.SUCCESS_YN , TO_CHAR(A.DEPLOY_DATE, 'Mon DD YYYY') AS DEPLOY_DATE , A.RESULT_MSG FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_HST AS A WHERE (A.DEPLOY_PROC_SEQ = #{deployProcSeq})
AND (A.DEPLOY_GB = #{deployGb})
ORDER BY A.SEQ DESC

/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selApiList */ SELECT APIDEF.API_NO, APIDEF.API_SPC_NO, APIDEF.API_NM, APIDEF.API_CTGRY_NO, APIDEF.API_PATH, APIDEF.METHOD_CD, APIDEF.API_ID, APIDEF.API_DESC, APIDEF.REG_DT, APIDEF.REGR, APIDEF.AMD_DT, APIDEF.AMDR, APIDEF.SORT_ODRG, APIDEF.SHOW_STATUS_CD, APIDEF.USE_YN, APIDEF.API_GUBUN, APIDEF.API_HANDLER_CD, APIDEF.API_VER, (SELECT SEQ FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC WHERE API_NO = APIDEF.API_NO ORDER BY SEQ DESC LIMIT 1) AS PROC_SEQ FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF AS APIDEF INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC AS APISPC ON APIDEF.API_SPC_NO = APISPC.API_SPC_NO WHERE 1 = 1 ORDER BY API_NO DESC LIMIT 300

/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selApiTreeList */ SELECT A.* FROM ( SELECT SYS_NM, SPC.API_NM SPC_NM, APIDEF.API_NM, DEPLOYPROC.SEQ FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC AS DEPLOYPROC INNER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD AS COMNCD ON DEPLOYPROC.DEPLOY_CD = COMNCD.COMN_CD INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF AS APIDEF ON DEPLOYPROC.API_NO = APIDEF.API_NO INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC AS SPC ON APIDEF.API_SPC_NO = SPC.API_SPC_NO INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM AS APISYSTEM ON SPC.SYS_ID = APISYSTEM.SYS_ID INNER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD AS VERICD ON DEPLOYPROC.VERIFI_CD = VERICD.COMN_CD WHERE APISYSTEM.SYS_ID = (SELECT APISYSTEM.SYS_ID FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC AS DEPLOY_PROC INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF AS APIDEF ON DEPLOY_PROC.API_NO = APIDEF.API_NO INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC AS APISPC ON APIDEF.API_SPC_NO = APISPC.API_SPC_NO INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM AS APISYSTEM ON APISPC.SYS_ID = APISYSTEM.SYS_ID LIMIT 1) ) A WHERE (1=1)
AND A.SEQ = #{seq}

/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selDelApiSearch */ SELECT APIDEF.API_NO, APIDEF.API_NM, APIDEF.API_PATH, APIDEF.API_ID, TO_CHAR(APIDEF.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') REG_DT, APIDEF.API_VER, APIDEF.API_VER_NO, APISPC.API_NM AS SPC_NM FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF APIDEF INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC APISPC ON APIDEF.API_SPC_NO = APISPC.API_SPC_NO WHERE UPPER(APIDEF.API_NM) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER(#{apiNm}) , '%') ORDER BY APIDEF.REG_DT DESC

/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selDeployApplySearch */ SELECT APIDEF.API_NM , APIDEF.API_NO , DEPLOYAPPLY.BIGO, TO_CHAR(DEPLOYAPPLY.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') REG_DT, DEPLOYAPPLY.SEQ FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_APPLY DEPLOYAPPLY INNER JOIN KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC DEPLOYPROC ON DEPLOYAPPLY.DEPLOY_PROC_SEQ = DEPLOYPROC.SEQ INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF APIDEF ON DEPLOYPROC.API_NO = APIDEF.API_NO WHERE UPPER(APIDEF.API_NM) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER(#{apiNm}) , '%')

/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selDeployStateTotal */ SELECT DEPLOY_PROC.SEQ SEQ, DEPLOY_COMNCD.CD_NM DEPLOY_CDNM, VERIFI_COMNCD.CD_NM VERIFI_CDNM, DEPLOY_COMNCD.PRNTS_CD PRNTS_CD, APISYSTEM.SYS_NM, SPC.API_NM CTGRY_NM, DEF.API_NM, DEPLOY_PROC.DEPLOY_CD, DEPLOY_PROC.VERIFI_CD, DEPLOY_PROC.regr, TO_CHAR(DEPLOY_PROC.REG_DT, 'Mon DD YYYY') REG_DT, COALESCE(DEPLOY_PROC.BIGO,'') BIGO, COALESCE(DEF.API_VER,'') API_VER, DEF.API_ID, 0 REQUIRED_CNT FROM KOA_TB_COMN_CD AS DEPLOY_COMNCD INNER JOIN KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC AS DEPLOY_PROC ON DEPLOY_COMNCD.COMN_CD = DEPLOY_PROC.DEPLOY_CD INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF AS DEF ON DEPLOY_PROC.API_NO = DEF.API_NO INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC AS SPC ON DEF.API_SPC_NO = SPC.API_SPC_NO INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM AS APISYSTEM ON SPC.SYS_ID = APISYSTEM.SYS_ID INNER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD AS VERIFI_COMNCD ON DEPLOY_PROC.VERIFI_CD = VERIFI_COMNCD.COMN_CD WHERE APISYSTEM.SYS_NM ='KOS' ORDER BY DEF.REG_DT DESC

/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selMailByApiRegrNAmdr */ SELECT (SELECT EMAIL FROM V2OA_TB_USER_INFO WHERE USER_ID = KOA_TB_API_DEF.REGR) AS REG_EMAIL, (SELECT EMAIL FROM V2OA_TB_USER_INFO WHERE USER_ID = KOA_TB_API_DEF.AMDR) AS EDIT_EMAIL FROM KOA_TB_API_DEF WHERE API_NO = #{apiNo}
/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selMailByUserid */ SELECT COALESCE(EMAIL,'') AS EMAIL FROM KOA_TB_MBR WHERE MBR_ID = #{regr}

/* com.kt.openapi.web.apiDeploy.dao.ApiDeployDAO.selApiNmByprocseq */ SELECT API_DEF.API_NM, API_SPC.API_NM AS SPC_NM, API_SYSTEM.SYS_NM AS SYS_NM FROM KOA_TB_DEPLOY_PROC DEPLOY_PROC INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF API_DEF ON DEPLOY_PROC.API_NO = API_DEF.API_NO INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SPC API_SPC ON API_DEF.API_SPC_NO = API_SPC.API_SPC_NO INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM API_SYSTEM ON API_SPC.SYS_ID = API_SYSTEM.SYS_ID WHERE DEPLOY_PROC.SEQ = #{seq}
